reviews.text:
😠 Maison Margiela Hannam, worst experience damaging brand value (1 star rating)
After visiting [Maison Margiela Hannam], I had the worst experience where my expectations for the brand changed from disappointment to shock. I visited out of curiosity about the space that was a renovated building from the 1970s, but the staff's inappropriate response destroyed all of this value.
1. Unpleasant discrimination under the guise of misunderstanding foreigners
The moment I took a quick picture at the entrance of the store, an employee came up to me and responded in plain English, “You are not allowed to take pictures here.”
* Even though I look Korean, I was very embarrassed and offended that I had to use English. Despite looking at the person's face and saying "yes" in Korean, the employee continued working without any apology or explanation. Even taking into account the fact that there are many foreign tourists, this is a reception method that creates an unnecessary sense of difference to Korean visitors.
2. Monitoring and warnings that treat guests as potential ‘problem children’
What's even more surprising is that the entire time we went up to the second floor terrace, the employee followed behind us and monitored us to the point of being burdensome. Soon, when we got close to the terrace, we didn't even lean on the railing, but he immediately made an absurd warning remark, "It's a bit awkward to lean on the terrace..."
* This behavior treated the guest as a potential troublemaker, and in effect felt like an unspoken pressure to “leave out.” A minimal welcome or “Is there something you’re looking for?” Without even the same basic response, only vigilance and surveillance filled this space.
3. Serious damage to brand value
I am not looking for kindness or excessive service. However, we believe that the value of a space and brand is ultimately completed through ‘experience and feeling.’ No matter how nicely decorated a space is, the moment you have a negative experience, the brand becomes **'a place that brings up unpleasant feelings just by passing by'**.
The fact that 3 out of 8 reviews from others are negative proves that this issue is not just one person's sensitivity.
We strongly request this from [Maison Margiela Hannam].
* Improve or discontinue employee response: **'burden disguised as kindness'** creates a negative image with customers and will ultimately become a fatal issue for brand value. If you find it difficult to respond, then don't do it.
* Install clear notices: The prohibition on photography must be clearly communicated with signs. Coming up to a guest the moment they take a photo without any notice and unilaterally warning them sounds very negative.
* Measures for terrace management: If you are so concerned about leaning on the terrace railing, it is appropriate to install a “Do not lean” sign or, in the extreme case, close the terrace space. It is incomprehensible to give notice in advance that a guest may do something that he or she would not do (like leaning on the railing).
In conclusion, it was an experience that exceeded my expectations and gave me the worst day. If you are considering a visit, please be mindful of inappropriate response from staff.

MTL Hannam's Dessert aims to be an open space for both vegans and non-vegans, children and pets, so it was one of the cafes with the most diverse customer base among the cafes I've visited in Hannam-dong. Once you order drinks and desserts, they are brought to your seat and you just have to finish them and return them. Although the cafe was not large, the atmosphere was good enough that it could be said to be one of the hottest cafes in Hannam-dong because a variety of customers were constantly visiting, perhaps because children and pets were allowed.

The sign for More Than Less is not clearly visible, so it is easier to find it by searching for ‘May Bell Maple Branch’.
If you open the large heavy iron door on the first floor of the May Uijong Maple Branch and enter, you will find a wonderful space with industrial design and unique plants placed here and there :) The cafe has a high ceiling and four differently designed walls, so no matter how you take pictures, they all come out pretty, so you will find yourself taking pictures over and over again.

The coffee is delicious and the pound cake is moist.

There are works that pay homage to the nostalgic character Atom, dishes made with lacquer work, and unique works and paintings, so the space gives the feeling of entering the artist's studio rather than a cafe. The H.M.W set, which allows you to enjoy artist Heo Myeong-wook's tableware all at once, includes black sesame bean paste, fruit, and Americano, at a reasonable price. Big Apple (Columbia Kindio Pink Bourbon, honey/green apple and fermentation)
These coffee beans are called flavored coffee. After carbonic fermentation, Mosto juice is injected into the coffee, and in the second fermentation, it is steeped with green apples for 72 hours. At first, I drank a latte with this unique flavored coffee and wondered what it was. The taste was truly unique.  Are there scents other than coffee, like milk tea?
